item.description: I am watching a video on why I feel sleepy when I start studying. Its not diet, exercise or energy deficiency. It is a more emotional issue. What is your brain predicting when you sit down to study? Some emotions protect you from other emotions. Anger Anger protects you from shame, you go defensive for your ego. Frustration Similarly tiredness is a secondary emotion.

The people pleasing says “I need everyone to approve of me.” The ego says “I’m more mature than everyone.” Both are ways of keeping people at a distance. One through over-inclusion, one through quiet superiority. Neither lets real connection in. The advice is the same for both: Get curious instead of comparative. Instead of pre-deciding someone can’t handle something, get genuinely curious about them. You might be surprised. The “I’m more mature” feeling fades when you actually discover depth in people you’d written off.

Hi Utsab. Today I want to write about a person whose story deeply moved me. John Hudson. A kid about my age who had been battleling with an awful disease called EB (Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB) is a family of life-threatening rare genetic disorders that affect the body’s largest organ: the skin.) I came across his story through the yt channel called “special books by special kids”. John was always in so much pain, yet you could see his strength and character which seemed to over his situation.

Lesson #1000 smth smth I seem to be a spending more time scrolling twitter and youtube watching stuff that I want to do and bookmarking things than actually doing those. This is leading to a anxiety, loss of morale, underconfidence. Lets go back to the habit to doing courses, at your own pace, the world is moving too fast but is it really? most work is still done pretty slow. So its not that you don’t have time, its just that you have been disillusioned to think than slow and steady won’t make it now.

Hi Utsab. Summer Vacation is almost ending . My internship work has yet to take form but it will take time as I was told by my guide since the domain is pretty broad. So given the fact that I got exposure to a bit of continual, curriculum and representation learning and also a bit of interpretebility I think I should take up 2 problem directions independent on this work which I can slowly dive in as a hobby and expand.

Hi Utsab. Today is one of those days where I am stressing out way too much, regarding things which don’t matter that much to me. I think I am again high on stimuli, too much signal, too much work to do, too many goals to accomplish, too many people to compare with. This ego will honestly be the end of me. I think the announcements of the Internship CDC drive is what triggered this.

Hey Utsab. I will admit that work has been slow. I am writing rn in hopes that my head gets more clarity regarding some things. I need to calm down basically. Once again I am starting to take load by taking up multiple things at the same time and then feeling frustrated that neither is working out. I want to write down basically what I want to do and then stick to that only for the remainitng 1 month or so of summer.

Okay so I relapsed. I yanked my tank. Idk how I got in the moment after not feeling it for so many days. But damn it has been 12 days. But I’ll start again. Nothing to bother about. 12 days is good. but what is better is the fact that being involved in work actually helped get ts out of my mind(well most of the time). Also I think I might have a hypothesis regarding what triggered my relapse.

Hello hello. Today went well. Did a decent amount of lit review, more in depth than breadth. Got quite a few ideas regarding things than can possibly be done in this field of data efficient learning/continual learning. The problem statement suddenly seems much more interesting than it did a few days ago. I realise I have been wasting some time during my work so I have started staying off of social media.

item.title: 2025-05-03- Motivation?
item.description: I have my flight to bangalore tomorrow morning. Have good summer planned at VAL, IISc hopefully getting some good work done . Will probably learn quite a bit. But for some reason the idea of doing research or going outside is not hitting the happiness meter as I thought it would. This might be due to the excessively hectic college semester that I just finished. Probably needed a break. Been doom scrolling and watching weird YT videos.

This is the first entry of this Obsidian journal. I have no idea whether I will be maintaining it or just forget about it. Idk why I am writing but I think just spamming the keyboard with words is a way of venting out in my own way. So whoever is reading this in the future dont expect me to maintain proper grammar or sentence structuring. I’ll maybe write about my thoughts or just some things that are on my mind.

item.description: Questions to ask: What is his research on? Scope of joining corporate R&D corporate vs academia how does he get his ideas? how feasible is it financially? I have tried penning down a lot of my ideas and work thanks to my obssession with Obsidian this year. Not sure if I managed to build my “second brain” yet but things are easier to lookup for sure.
